# Primed Grocery Shopping - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
A Flutter shopping list app with two modes: edit mode (manage items) and shopping mode (check off purchased items). Features include item reordering, local persistence with SharedPreferences, and undo functionality for deleted items.

## User Instructions
- I'm a software developer using Dart/Flutter for the first time so keep your responses brief and insightful (from a beginner's perspective). Feel free to refactor parts of the application to improve readability, maintainability, and performance. Focus on best practices for Flutter development, such as using state management solutions (e.g., Provider, Riverpod) and optimizing widget rebuilds.

- Ensure feature requests are tested and well categorized (eg UI, state management).
